gh_484b4bfff912b720db1a2be5.title: Fellowlane (recruitment agency) - Back-end Developer .NET/C# - Schiphol-Rijk, Netherlands (Hybrid) - From 4,500 EUR/Month
gh_484b4bfff912b720db1a2be5.description:
**Language requirement: Dutch proficiency is mandatory. Beheersing van het Nederlands is verplicht.**

## What You Will Get

### Salary and hours
- From EUR 4,500 gross/month, based on 40 hours, depending on experience.
- 32–40 hours per week.

### Location and benefits
- Schiphol-Rijk, Netherlands; hybrid, partly from home and partly at the office. This is not a worldwide remote position.
- A small development team with direct influence on architecture and technical decisions.
- Work on a growing electric-mobility platform contributing to the energy transition.

## What You Will Do
- Develop and maintain the back-end in .NET Core 10 and C#.
- Build and maintain APIs and integrations with external systems.
- Process and validate large amounts of data.
- Work with Azure to keep the platform reliable and scalable.
- Collaborate with a small team and contribute to architecture decisions.

## Skills
### Must have
- Approximately five years of back-end development experience.
- Strong .NET Core and C# knowledge and experience with Azure.
- Bachelor-level working and thinking ability.
- Initiative and comfort working in a growing environment.

### Nice to have
- API/integration and high-volume data-processing experience.
- Interest in energy or electric mobility.

## About the company and recruiter
Fellowlane is a recruitment agency recruiting on behalf of a growing Dutch company in electric mobility. This is a role with our client, not an internal Fellowlane position. The client name is shared during the introductory conversation.

## How to apply
[Full vacancy and application form (Dutch)](https://fellowlane.com/vacature/recruitee-back-end-developer-net-core-10c/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=techmasters#formulier)

Questions: [info@fellowlane.com](mailto:info@fellowlane.com), +31 297 30 81 51.
Please apply through the website and do not post your CV or personal details in this public issue.
